title: 感情・人格心理学
subtitle: Psychology of Emotion and Personality
educationalGoal: Students will understand methodology and theories related to the psychology of emotion and personality. Students will: (1) learn theories of emotion and interaction between emotion and cognition. (2) learn the function of emotion from the perspective of evolutionary theory. (3) learn how modern personality research has developed. (4) understand the outline of modern personality psychology research.
advice: We will cover the following topics: Classes1-8: Psychology of emotion 1. Definition and kinds of emotion 2. Interaction between emotion and cognition 3. Function of emotion from the perspective of evolutionary theory 4. Methodology of the psychology of emotion Classes 9-15: Psychology of personality 1. The concept of personality and its formation process 2. Major personality theories 3. Basic methods of personality psychology This subject is eligible for the course credit system.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” course is required.
